title: MCP Phase 3/4 Convergence — Scan + ReceiptEnvelope Composition v1 — Rig Relay

for_every_mcp_tools_call.behavior: verify descriptor hash, quarantine on drift, refuse with receipt metadata
block mutation tier, refuse git-release tier, refuse forbidden tools, persist outcome
validate workspace root, refuse path traversal/symlink escape, emit receipt-compatible metadata
execute tool handler (real or stub), produce dispatch_result
classify output, refuse secret-bearing/forbidden-raw, attach classification
build ReceiptEnvelope with correct content_light_classification, persist via receipt_store
merge surface/capability/authority fields, set request_id, return to client

async_sync_parity.call_tool: Steps 1-7 as above. Uses _dispatch() for async execution.
async_sync_parity.call_tool_sync: Steps 1-7 as above. Uses _dispatch_sync() for sync execution. Same pipeline, same refusal metadata, same persistence path.

refusal_cases_covered.behavior: returns JSON-RPC error {error, code: -32601} with persistence. Not a structured refusal.

receipt_metadata_fields.content_light_classification: Read from outcome dict content_light_classification field. Not hardcoded to public_safe.
receipt_metadata_fields.request_id: Generated once at start of call_tool/call_tool_sync. Reused across all gates. Overrides any internal request_id from _build_refusal.
receipt_metadata_fields.descriptor_id: Present in _build_refusal for registered tools. None for root-scope refusals where tool name is a path.
receipt_metadata_fields.persist_outcome: Called on every outcome path (success, refusal, block, error). Silently passes if receipt_store is None.

remaining_seams.phase_5_auth: MCPPerUserAuthorization model exists but not enforced. No per-session token required for any operation.
remaining_seams.unknown_tool_format: Unknown tools return {error, code: -32601} (JSON-RPC error) rather than a structured refusal with content_light, surface, etc. This is consistent with JSON-RPC protocol but means unknown-tool errors have a different schema than other refusals.
remaining_seams.pre_existing_seam: Sync handler process_jsonrpc_sync lacks tools/call dispatch.

mcp_security_implications.composition_order: Descriptor integrity → tier gating → root boundary → dispatch → content-light scan → receipt persistence → response. This is defense-in-depth: descriptor trust is established first, authority is checked second, filesystem scope is verified third, only then is tool code invoked. Output is scanned before serialization. Every outcome (including refusals) is persisted as a receipt envelope.
mcp_security_implications.scan_failure_persistence: If content-light scan refuses output, the refusal (not the raw output) is returned and persisted. Receipt metadata records the correct classification (secret_bearing or forbidden_raw) without echoing the detected secret.
mcp_security_implications.persistence_failure_safety: If receipt_store.append() raises, the exception is caught silently and does not prevent the refusal or result from being returned. No unsafe output is returned on persistence failure.

next_recommended_mcp_slice: Phase 5: Local Session Auth. Wrap stdio transport with per-session token generated at startup. Instantiate MCPPerUserAuthorization per request. Enforce tier-scoped authorization.
